name: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
publisher: arXiv (Li, Wei, Zhang, Zhang; Peking University / Microsoft Research / University of Waterloo)
notes: EAGLE performs autoregression at feature (second-to-top-layer) level, reusing top-layer features from target model. For LLaMA2-Chat 70B: 2.7x-3.5x latency speedup, doubled throughput. Uses tree-structured draft allowing alternative branches on rejection (vs chain-structured standard speculative sampling). Ranked first on Spec-Bench at time of submission.
